d:
Bihar men subah aur rat ke samay halki thand ka ehsas hone laga hai, jabki din men tapman samany bana huaa hai.
Mausam vibhag ne 13 se 19 navanbar tak ka purvanuman jari kiya hai, jismen barish ki sanbhavna nahin jataee gaee hai.
Janie patna, gaya, bhagalpur, purniya samet bihar ke sabhi mausam kshetron men agle sat dinon ka hal.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
